# Preface {.unnumbered}

**The Geometry of Motion** is a three-volume series unifying the physics and architecture of control systems that navigate the real world, prioritizing trajectory confinement over static destinations.

- **Volume 0**: The Mathematical Primer
- **Volume I**: Foundations of Exact Linearization and Contraction
- **Volume II**: Transverse Control and The Architecture of Trajectories

*This series is available as a Quarto-rendered HTML edition and a LaTeX-typeset PDF. Some figures (TikZ diagrams) render only in the PDF edition; the HTML edition substitutes placeholders where necessary.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Relationship to Tangent Hyperplane Contraction (THC)

The GoM series is the formal academic manuscript for this material. The [Tangent Hyperplane Contraction workspace](../../tangent-hyperplane-contraction/index.html) (THC) covers overlapping content in a more concise, website-oriented 8-chapter format. Volume I of GoM and the THC workspace cover similar foundational topics (linearization, contraction, optimal control) but are developed independently with different scope and presentation style. GoM aims for full mathematical rigor; THC prioritizes practical implementation guidance.
:::
